title: ETSI TS 103 705 Types schema
description: JSON schema for ETSI-defined types (see clause 6.1 and Annex A)

CSPSubscriberRecord.title: CSP Subscriber Record
CSPSubscriberRecord.description: A CSP's subscriber record. May contain four different addresses, which are often set to the same value

subscriberName.description: Name of subscriber (obviously a real definition would be more complex

registeredAddress.description: Points to the address registered as part of the service

deliveryAddress.description: Points to the address used for delivery

billingAddress.description: Points to the address used for billing

contactAddress.description: Points to the address used for mailing purposes

CSPAddressRecord.title: CSP Address Record
CSPAddressRecord.description: A simple address structure (for example purporses - a standard ETSI one is needed, FFS)
